stories.h: Congo begins frontline Ebola vaccination campaign
stories.w: Health authorities launched a 20,000-person campaign for health and frontline workers in Bunia and Mongbwalu as the Bundibugyo-virus outbreak reached 7,541 confirmed cases and 3,639 deaths; WHO says the vaccine is being studied because no licensed vaccine yet targets this strain.

stories.h: German election defeats put Merz's reform agenda under pressure
stories.w: The CDU fell below the 5% threshold in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, its first ejection from a state legislature in modern Germany, while dropping behind the Left Party in Berlin, weakening Chancellor Friedrich Merz as he pursues pension and healthcare reforms.

stories.h: Climate Week puts AI's energy demand at the center of global talks
stories.w: Leaders opened Climate Week in New York as a new scientific assessment found seven of nine planetary boundaries breached and the UN climate chief warned that data centers are driving fossil-fuel demand and household energy costs, sharpening pressure for faster renewable deployment.
